title: Asymmetric Supercapacitor with MXene Electrodes
abstract: An electrochemical storage device with Ti3C2Tx MXene positive electrode and N-doped carbon negative electrode achieving 50 Wh/kg at 10 kW/kg with 100,000 cycle life.
claims: MXene electrode with interlayer spacing 1.2-1.5 nm by DMSO intercalation.
Asymmetric cell with MXene positive and N-doped carbon negative in 1M H2SO4.
MXene synthesis by selective etching of Al from Ti3AlC2 using LiF/HCl at 35C for 24h.
problem_statement: Batteries offer high energy but low power. Supercapacitors offer high power but low energy. MXenes may bridge this gap.
